scripts.install:all: npm install && cd backend && npm install && cd ../frontend && npm install
scripts.dev: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "blue,green" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev"
scripts.dev:tunnel: concurrently --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND,TUNNEL" --prefix-colors "blue,green,magenta" "cd backend && npm run dev" "cd frontend && npm run dev" "node tunnel.js"
